content_zh:
这天一早，师主任对胡悦轻描淡写地一句吩咐，在办公室几乎激起千重浪——胡悦，正式从王医生那里回来了！
十六院每年招新，别的科室人数都不多，但整形美容中心例外，这行业这几年火得过分，外头挖角的力度也大，五万十万的月薪那都是针对主治医师的，副主任自己出去做，一年没有几百万都不好意思和人打招呼，如果是自己投资开医院，那赚的钱可就没数了。就算是十六院这样的名牌大医院也留不住人，每年都得招新。
——这其中当然也不是没有新人想要搞定师医生，不过，大多数人最后都成为马医生的劳动力，头最铁的也很少从王医生那里幸存回来：病历、报告都轮不上写，每天光是做苦力，塞假体拉钩，病号都不能接，得到的提升其实有限，不是每个想做面部结构的人都能经得住这样的磨练，也不是每个人都在一周时间内上手，得到王医生认可的。
这个‘四合一’的所谓研究生，不管是运气还是实力，居然真能回到师医生身边，被他承认为自己小组的一员……马医生组里几个挑战失败的住院医都有点受不了了，尤其是戴韶华，更是气哼哼的，“连病号都没法接，只能去理病历，她根本没资格进十九层。”
这话也不无道理，她在国外是有对口实习经验的，俄罗斯的整形美容也异常发达，富豪名媛间常以鼻部手术后贴的横条胶布为荣，四处炫耀——西方人鼻子大，针对鼻部的整形是最旺的，戴韶华和胡悦一样是颌面修复专业，不过她对自己规划好，假期进了整容诊所实习，经验是比胡悦丰富得多。她也知道本专业的实习都是什么德行，“看着是像，其实根本就不一样，她整个硕士都在做鼻咽癌术后修复吧，那种功能性的手术和咱们这种根本没可比性，师主任叫她去整理病历也对，病历不整理，她怎么接病号？连该做什么手术她都弄不清楚。”
这是实话，颌面修复很多转整形的，毕竟两个专业共同之处不少，胡悦的大学就在本地，她读研期间都在做什么不是秘密，医学界还是不大，尤其是本地院校，更是有千丝万缕的关系，谢芝芝前几天找同学噶珊瑚，随随便便就摸了个八.九不离十——跟的导师的确是好的，能进十六院说不准也是导师推荐，不过读研期间真的几乎都在跟老师一起做颌面重建：许多鼻咽癌患者手术以后，颌面骨骼也会随病灶一起切除，这种重建一般是以重建骨骼功能为主，恢复患者原有面容为附加目标。和整容这一块为了追求美观的面部结构手术，只能说是手法相似，但目标就完全南辕北辙。比起同期的戴韶华，胡悦各方面是都要落后好几步了。
戴韶华吃饭的时候经常这样幸灾乐祸地讲讲胡悦的事，谢芝芝之前也笑眯眯地听，但现在却有点后悔，她没想到胡悦还真能回师主任手下，“师主任也不是这样想吧，但我们不是在推无纸化办公好几年了吗，师主任手下的病历一直没清出来，组里没人嘛，现在有人弄了，行政那边不知多开心。”
“哇，这还不叫为难？”戴韶华眼睛瞪得大大的，哗然说，“是不是要把胡悦分派去刷厕所才叫为难她啊？”
住院医师虽然是医院食物链的最下层，但这也不是古代了，就算是古代，他们怎么也算是个小主，不得上头欢心的话，最多也就是在工作上被穿穿小鞋：一个住院医师，要锻炼他最好的办法就是让他去接病号，写医嘱，跟着一起上台做手术。虽然其中也免不得被骂，但成长却也是迅速的。要折磨他，最好的办法就是让他去买饭、买水，写各种学习报告，写行政文档……
一样是加班加到死，但这种班加得却很搓火，不但累而且没成长，三五年下来都不上台，人就真的废了。戴韶华对胡悦心态很复杂，又是幸灾乐祸又有点羡慕妒忌恨——不管怎么说，现在她总是师主任身边的近人，戴韶华女性的一面有时候也会起点作用：一个男神身边总是没有女人，忽然间出现一个愣头愣脑的小徒弟，就算被他亲口嫌过丑，同龄女人心里也还是会有点怪怪的。
“多看点病历也算是熟悉业务，有帮助的。”申永峰也不知道是为师主任说话，还是不喜欢戴韶华的语气。

content_en:
Early that morning, the division director gave Hu Yue a casual order, which almost caused a thousand waves in the office - Hu Yue is officially back from Dr. Wang!
The Sixteenth Hospital recruits new people every year, and the number of people in other departments is not large, except for the plastic surgery center. This industry has become too popular in recent years, and external poaching efforts are also fierce. The monthly salary of 50,000 yuan is for the attending physician. The deputy director goes out to do it by himself. Without millions a year, he is embarrassed to say hello to people. If you invest in opening a hospital by yourself, the money you make will be endless. Even big, famous hospitals like the Sixteenth Hospital cannot retain people and have to recruit new ones every year.
——Of course, there are no newcomers who want to be doctors. However, most people eventually become Dr. Ma's workforce, and the most stubborn ones rarely survive from Dr. Wang: they can't write medical records and reports. They just do hard work every day, insert prosthetic retractors, and can't take any patients. The improvement is actually limited. Not everyone who wants to do facial structure can withstand such a test, and not everyone can get started within a week and get the approval of Dr. Wang.
This so-called "four-in-one" graduate student, whether it was luck or strength, actually returned to the doctor and was recognized by him as a member of his group... Several residents in Dr. Ma's group who failed the challenge were a little bit unbearable, especially Dai Shaohua.
This is not unreasonable. She has internship experience abroad, and plastic surgery in Russia is also extremely developed. Rich and famous ladies are often proud of the horizontal strips of tape they put on after nose surgeries and show them off everywhere - Westerners have big noses, so nose plastic surgery is the most popular. Dai Shaohua, like Hu Yue, majors in maxillofacial restoration, but she planned herself well and went to a plastic surgery clinic for internship during the holidays. She has much more experience than Hu Yue. She also knows the ethics of internships in this major. "It looks like it, but in fact it is completely different. She must have spent her entire master's degree doing post-operative repair of nasopharyngeal cancer. That kind of functional surgery is not comparable to ours. The director of the division is right to ask her to sort out the medical records. If the medical records are not sorted out, how can she answer the patient's call? She can't even figure out what surgery to do."
This is the truth. Many people in maxillofacial repair turn to plastic surgery. After all, the two majors have a lot in common. Hu Yue’s university is in the local area. It is no secret what she was doing during her graduate studies. The medical field is still not big, especially the local universities, which are inextricably linked. Xie Zhizhi was looking for a classmate’s coral a few days ago and casually touched it 10 - The tutor I followed was indeed good. I might have been admitted to the 16th Hospital because of the tutor's recommendation. However, during my postgraduate studies, I almost always did maxillofacial reconstruction with the teacher: after many nasopharyngeal cancer patients undergo surgery, their maxillofacial bones will also be removed along with the lesions. This kind of reconstruction usually focuses on rebuilding bone function, with the additional goal of restoring the patient's original face. It can only be said that the technique is similar to plastic surgery, which is a facial structure surgery that pursues beauty, but the goal is completely different. Compared with Dai Shaohua in the same period, Hu Yue is several steps behind in all aspects.
Dai Shaohua often gloated about Hu Yue's affairs during meals. Xie Zhizhi listened with a smile before, but now she feels a little regretful. She didn't expect that Hu Yue could really return to the division director. "That's not what the division director thinks, but haven't we been promoting paperless office for several years? The medical records under the division director have not been cleared out. There is no one in the group. Now someone has done it. I don't know how happy the administration is."
"Wow, isn't this called an embarrassment?" Dai Shaohua's eyes widened and he said in an uproar, "Does it mean that Hu Yue has to be assigned to clean the toilet to embarrass her?"
Although resident doctors are at the bottom of the hospital food chain, this is not ancient times. Even in ancient times, they can still be regarded asIf you are a small boss, if you don't like your superiors, the most you can do is to be put on the back foot at work: for a resident physician, the best way to train him is to ask him to take patients, write medical orders, and follow him on stage to perform operations. Although he was inevitably scolded, his growth was rapid. The best way to torture him is to make him buy food and water, write various study reports, and write administrative documents...
It's the same as working overtime until death, but this kind of overtime is very stressful. Not only is it tiring, but there is no growth. If you don't go on stage for three to five years, you will be really useless. Dai Shaohua has a complicated attitude toward Hu Yue, gloating about his misfortune and a bit envious, jealous, and resentful. Anyway, now she is always close to the division director. Dai Shaohua's female side sometimes comes into play: there are always no women around a male god, and suddenly a dumb little apprentice appears. Even if he personally thinks he is ugly, women of the same age will still feel a little weird.
"Reading more medical records is a sign of familiarity with the business, which will be helpful." Shen Yongfeng didn't know whether he was speaking for the division director or if he didn't like Dai Shaohua's tone.
